scope: Cortex-M0+ binary64 addition of nearby opposite signs, compared with Qfplib-M0-full on the RP2040.

implementation.nearby: For biased exponent gaps 0/1, form an exact unsigned difference of at most 54 bits. Equal exponents and every difference fitting 53 bits pack exactly; a 54-bit difference needs one nearest-even tie step.
implementation.normalization: Normalize two integer limbs in 16/8/4/1-bit steps, with a short path for small cancellation; no 96-bit sticky limb or signed unpacking is needed in the nearby path.
implementation.zero: Equal opposite magnitudes return +0 under nearest-even before packing an exponent.
implementation.far: Reuse the signed decoded exponent gap: for opposite signs at least 55 exponent steps apart, return the larger input exactly. The threshold also covers the smaller ULP below a power of two.
implementation.ieee: Existing guards route zero/subnormal/NaN/infinity/extreme-exponent inputs to the unchanged independent IEEE fallback.
implementation.license: Existing BSD-3-Clause Pico SDK foundation with independent project changes; Qfplib remains an external separately linked comparison APP.

armv6m.abi: Cortex-M0, soft EABI registers, R4-R11/SP preserved; writes stack and SIO divider only
armv6m.timing_note: Instruction counts are emulator diagnostics, not measured RP2040 cycles.

production_fast_path_bytes.scope: Read-only byte comparison: subtraction entry and all addition fast paths in the production ELF exactly match the independently tested ARM binary. No ELF execution or external fallback relocation check is performed.

production_elf_execution.reason: Two extra emulator launches were not executed because automatic approval review failed: selected review model was at capacity. This was not an unsafe-action determination. Production addition machine code was instead compared byte-for-byte with the tested ARM ELF.

physical_math.location: Local compact_math and owned arithmetic execute in SRAM; no resident math imports.

tests.map_gate: PASS: no extracted libgcc archive members
